## Layer `BlazorAdmin`

This directory contains the `BlazorAdmin` layer. BlazorAdmin is the Blazor WebAssembly admin client that runs in the browser and calls PublicApi. Its architecture rules:

- `layering/blazor-admin-client-only` — The BlazorAdmin layer must reference only the BlazorShared layer (external packages are not constrained by this rule). BlazorAdmin runs in the browser and reaches the server only through PublicApi over HTTP. BlazorShared is the one project it shares with the server.
- Expand any rule above with `sliderule explain <rule-id>`.
